label: CREATURE_2: having one's being caused by some other being
term: creature, broad gloss (caused in being by another; Lean `IsCausedInBeingByAnother`)
definition: IsCausedInBeingByAnother CausesIn esse x: some being c other than x causes x's being (∃ c, c ≠ x ∧ CausesIn c x esse). The broad gloss earlier given to 'creature' in 'Whatever has its being caused by something distinct from it is a creature' (ordered to some cause of its being). Example: a being whose being a secondary cause causes. Counterexample: a being whose being nothing other than it causes. It does not say that the cause is God, a first cause or a cause of the being of everything else; that is CREATURE_1 (DEF-CREATURE).
note: Analyst sense, recorded so that the broad and the narrow (q.13 a.5) readings of 'creature' are distinct Lean declarations (DISAMB c49de1e9-c34f-424f-b144-b80c885974ca). CREATURE_1 entails CREATURE_2 by definition (creature1_isCausedInBeingByAnother); the converse is the substantive passage 'Whatever is CREATURE_2 is CREATURE_1' (b7d4eede-ab50-5522-8902-f33238fa234d), derived from the Fourth-Way consequence STMT-MAXIMAL-CAUSE-WITHOUT-DISTINCT-ESSE-CAUSE and a weak premise. SCOPE CONDITION (definition 80dea550): the divine processions are no instances of CausesIn c x esse with c distinct from x.
